snippet.title: The Drunken Beard | Official Trailer | First Update
snippet.description: In The Drunken Beard, you take the reins of a lively tavern where every pint tells a story. Brew craft beers, manage orders between thirsty dwarves and impatient adventurers, expand the inn and turn it into a legendary haven. Between secret recipes, rustic furnishings, and demanding customers, only the finest innkeeper will win over hearts and livers. Glory awaits… one beer at a time!
